transport.peer: Linux SO_PEERCRED same effective uid on server and client
transport.frame: 4-byte unsigned big-endian length followed by UTF-8 JSON
transport.server_connection_deadline_ms: explicit1..2000; not renewed by each byte
transport.disconnect: no implicit cancellation, execution, or resubmit

json.strict: reject duplicate decoded keys, unknown fields, non-integer numbers, invalid UTF-8, NUL, oversized/deep documents
json.identifier: 1..128 ASCII alphanumeric or underscore/hyphen/dot/colon; registry identifiers, not paths
json.parameters: at most16 named boolean/integer/string<=128 scalars; each trusted adapter must additionally admit its own schema
json.artifact: index0..63; successful execution is not successful display
json.response: version,boot_id,ok, and exactly one of result/error; error has code/category/detail

security.ambiguous_response: retain original request/outcome; query same request identity, never resubmit work automatically

evidence.legacy_json: preserve exact bytes as an escaped string, never parse/re-encode its original numerical payload
evidence.publish: only after durable evidence; caller retains pending raw outcome on failure

implementation_status: transport and result store implemented; production Runtime/adapters and vxgpud integration remain U10+
